sentences.text:
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly. W.P.(CRL) 3066/2023 3.

The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:
"a) Allow the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for seeking directions for a speedy trial with respect to FIR No. 635/2016 dated 10/10/2016 U/S 498A, 304B,
306, 34 of I.P.C. filed at P.S. Binda Pur, New Delhi-110059, in the interest of justice and humanity.
b) Any other relief deems fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case may also be passed."
4. The present petition has been filed on behalf of the complainant in the This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/10/2023 at 00:14:30 present FIR.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that charges were framed in the present FIR on 16.05.2019.

It is pointed out that prosecution has cited 22 witnesses out of which,
only 1 witness has been examined-in-chief, in part and further examination has not taken place till date.
6. Issue notice.
7. Learned Additional Standing Counsel (Criminal) for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioner.
In the meantime, progress report from the concerned learned Trial Court be summoned before the next date of hearing.
10. Copy of this order be sent to the concerned learned Trial Court for necessary information and compliance.
AMIT SHARMA, J OCTOBER 18, 2023/bsr
